text.tspan: docker stop and PID 1: why some containers take 10 s to stop
PID 1 ignores signals it has no handler for, and must reap zombie children: use --init (tini) if the app forks.
Kubernetes sends the same SIGTERM on pod delete, then SIGKILL after 30 s (terminationGracePeriodSeconds).
